collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager is sure there are eels in the bathing stream: ask a friend about eels, or bathe somewhere else.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) loves bathing in the stream, except for one thing: (subject.he/she) is certain there are eels in it. (subject.He/she) has never actually seen one. But the water is brown in the deep part, and sometimes something brushes (subject.his/her) leg, and (subject.he/she) jumps clean out of the water. Today (friend) is bathing nearby and watching with interest.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides that the stream is the eels' business and finds a rock pool by the beach instead. It's warmer, shallower and perfectly clear. (subject.He/she) can see every pebble on the bottom. A small crab watches (subject.him/her) from a crack. (subject) decides (subject.he/she) can live with a crab.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Are there eels in here?" asks (subject). (friend) thinks. "Probably. Small ones. They don't bite people." (subject) doesn't find this as reassuring as (friend) meant it. (subject.He/she) bathes in the shallow part from then on, where the water is clear, and is much happier. The eels, presumably, are too.
